defs.def: the ability to see and understand the truth about people or situations 洞察力；领悟

ex.s: This mountain walk provides an insight into the skills required for hillwalking to ensure you get the most from future walking trips.
ex.t: 这次山地徒步让你了解山地徒步所需的技能，确保你在今后的徒步旅行中收获最大。

ex.s: Mr Bissell skillfully organizes historical insights and cultural references, making his tale a well-rounded picture of Uzbekistan, seen from Western eyes.
ex.t: 比塞尔先生巧妙地将历史洞察和文化参考编织在一起使他的故事成为从西方人眼中看到的乌兹别克斯坦的完整画面。

ex.s: History has the potential to break down those boundaries by offering us insight into entire worlds that would otherwise be foreign to us.
ex.t: 历史有潜力打破这些界限，让我们深入了解那些对我们来说原本陌生的世界。

ex.s: The work has also brought insights for museums, Smith says.
ex.t: 更重要的是，复原可能是了解珍宝在被时间磨损之前样貌的唯一途径。

ex.s: If we can rediscover the values of hands-on experience and craftwork, Smith says, we can marry the best of our modern insights with the handiness of our ancestors.
This insight grew from the determined attitude of a six-year-old boy who had the courage and perseverance to make his dream a reality.
ex.t: 这种领悟源于一个六岁男孩的坚定态度，他有勇气和毅力把自己的梦想变成现实。

ex.s: I admire Snow’s special insight and bravery, risking his life during the war to get to the heart of the story and correct prejudice.
ex.t: 我钦佩斯诺的非凡洞察力和勇气，他在战争中冒着生命危险去了解故事的核心，并纠正偏见。

ex.s: It has in fact become one of the most famous American poems of all time, not only because of its natural style, but also because of its thoughtful insights into human nature.
ex.t: 它实际上已经成为历史上最著名的美国诗歌之一，不仅因为其自然的风格，还因为其对人性深刻的洞察。

ex.s: After finishing it, I feel I have been given deeper insight into the world and can see things from a different point of view.
ex.t: 读完它，我感觉自己对这个世界的了解更深了，可以从不同的角度看待事物。

ex.s: The things around him look even more beautiful than before and have new meanings 3 After finishing it, I feel I have been given a deeper insight into the world and can see things from a different point of view.
ex.t: 他周围的事物看起来比以往更美丽，有了新的意义。读完它，我感觉自己对这个世界的了解更深了，可以从不同的角度看待事物。

defs.def: an understanding of what sth is like 洞悉；了解

ex.s: Smart recommendation engines analyze data such as exhibit popularity and visitors’ past behavior to suggest specific exhibits and events, making each visit unique and surprising. _____37_____ These digital assistants engage visitors in dynamic conversations and offer context-sensitive insights that deepen understanding and satisfy curiosity.
ex.t: 智能推荐引擎会分析展品受欢迎程度和参观者过往行为等数据，推荐特定的展品和活动，让每次参观都独一无二、充满惊喜。____ 这些数字助手与参观者进行动态对话，并提供契合情境的解说，加深理解、满足好奇心。
